title: Help sharing Family Lifetime plan
body:
Hello,

I am contacting you because I recently purchased the “Family Lifetime purchase for 5 members” plan. I chose this plan because I would like to use the app together with a friend, but I cannot figure out how to share the access so she can use it as well.

Could you please explain how I can invite or add another user to the family plan so we can use it together?

Thank you in advance for your assistance.

title: Hands down the best app
body: App has all the functionalities I need and even more!!! Great interface, tons of customization and statistics/habit overviews! And a very very adequate pricing model with an option to buy a lifetime membership! Also, the app creator is very responsive when it comes to bug reports/fixes! Worth every penny - definitely recommended!!

author: SimonaNKV

title: Change starts with simple habits
body: If you need a light push to adopt some new habits, then this is is - this app will be your partner along the way of personal development. It reduces the stress of having to think about consistently doing simple rituals by reminding you to do them throughout the day. I tested it myself and I’m seeing some noticeable results already. It’s just what I was looking for. Many thanks to the team!

title: Motivated for once
body: I’ve always been sceptical about this types of apps, but this time decided to give it a try. And this one was such a great choice! I’ve been using it for one month now, free version. The app is leading you for one better more organised life, which I love, Virgo ughhhh. There are some interface improvements that can be made but overall very easy to use. The app runs smoothly, haven’t glitches for me. It’s so nice to keep on your goals with something easy to check in. Being the it girl haven’t been easier! 🎀

title: Almost perfect
body: The app is really helpful and I thoroughly enjoy it. Therefore I even bought the subscription. But there is one problem- sometimes when I finish all my habits I don’t get the confetti animation even though it is turned on. I hope this problem is resolved soon since I deeply enjoy looking at it when I finish a good day.

title: Bug when pressing the back button
body: Hi Habit team. From all the apps I tried and payed for yours is the one truly enjoy. There is only one little thing that is a little bit annoying. When I open a certain habit- it takes few clicks to go back to the main page. It feels like the back button doesn’t always work straight away and it’s honestly annoying. I would be very pleased if you can solve that.
